Toroidal harmonics Readme

Short notes and references for the collection.

Mathematical concepts
Torus
A surface with two independent closed directions.
Torus knots
Integer winding numbers determine how a path closes.
Villarceau circles
Oblique cuts reveal two families of exact circles on a torus.
Braids and interlacing
Strands alternate above and below one another.
Periodic approximants
Repeating rational approximations let quasicrystalline patterns close around this torus.
Penrose tiling and quasicrystalline geometry
Ordered, nonperiodic rhomb patterns; these studies use periodic pentagrid approximants.
Cairo pentagons
A pentagonal tiling with fourfold organisation.
Kagome patterns
Corner-sharing triangles surround hexagonal openings.
Chair substitution
An L-shaped tile divides into four smaller chairs.
Sierpiński carpets
Repeatedly retain eight surrounding ninths; inlays keep the central squares as tiles.
Cantor-like constructions
Repeated paired divisions create nested strips and gaps.
Julia sets
Repeated complex squaring separates bounded orbits from escaping ones.
Möbius transformations
Complex fractional-linear maps carry circles and lines to circles and lines.
Jacobi theta functions
Balanced ratios of quasi-periodic Fourier series create doubly periodic fields with zeros and poles.
Poincaré-disk geometry
Hyperbolic distances place infinitely many equal-size regions inside a finite disk.
Farey fractions
Reduced rational numbers organise a hierarchy of scales.
Ford circles
A reduced fraction p/q gets a tangent circle of radius 1/(2q²).
Hamiltonian flows
A stream function generates area-preserving motion on the periodic coordinate chart.
Arnold cat-map
An integer torus map stretches and folds coordinates while preserving area.
Laplace–Beltrami eigenmodes
Natural standing-wave shapes computed for this curved torus.
Saddles, centres and separatrices
Critical points organise contours; saddle passages change which level-set regions connect.
Changing level-set connections
Crossing a saddle value joins or separates contour components.
Phase vortices
The phase winds around a zero of a complex field.
Truchet tilings
Simple tile orientations join local arcs into long paths.
Moore curves
A closed recursive space-filling curve, drawn here at finite depth.
Pythagorean dissections
Squares and triangles rearrange within a shared boundary.
Kirigami
Cuts let a sheet open into moving apertures and folds.
Origami
Creases coordinate the movement of connected panels.
Guilloché and engine-turned engraving
Repeated interlacing contours make finely engraved ornament.
Fourier interference
Complex waves add; their phases determine the resulting pattern.
Talbot revival
Quadratic Fourier phases reconstruct shifted copies at rational fractions of a cycle.
Dirac belt trick
A complete 720° turn can untwist continuously while the outer attachment stays fixed.
Phason flips
Local vertex rearrangements change tile adjacency in a quasicrystalline approximant.
Torus covering maps
Integer maps repeat one global organisation at successively smaller scales.
Recursion and scale
A construction repeats within its own smaller parts.
Quadtrees
Repeated four-way divisions organise nested square regions.
Golden ratio
Unequal parts repeat the same proportion at successive scales.
Voronoi cells
Each point belongs to its nearest moving seed.
Tessellation
Tiles share boundaries and fill a surface without gaps.
Rotational symmetry
Related orientations repeat around a common centre.
Artistic influences
M. C. Escher
Shared animal contours, figure–ground exchange and recursive worlds.
Étienne Jacob / bleuje
Precisely phased geometric loops and choreographed motion.
Wavegrower
Monochrome oscillations and collective waves of simple forms.
Alex Grey
Watching eyes, branching anatomy and visionary architecture.
Allyson Grey
Nested grids and the interplay of order and disorder.
